Run ENmix control-probe surrogate variable analysis

Source: R/svaEnmix.R
svaEnmix.Rd

Run ENmix control-probe surrogate variable analysis

svaEnmix(
  x = NULL,
  phenoFile = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/phenoLC.csv",
  rgsetData = "rData/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/objects/RGSet.RData",
  sepType = "",
  outputLogs = "logs",
  nSamples = NA,
  SampleID = "Sample_Name",
  arrayType = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2",
  annotationVersion = "20a1.hg38",
  SentrixIDColumn = "Sentrix_ID",
  SentrixPositionColumn = "Sentrix_Position",
  ctrlSvaPercVar = 0.9,
  ctrlSvaFlag = 1,
  scriptLabel = "svaEnmix",
  tiffWidth = 2000,
  tiffHeight = 1000,
  tiffRes = 150,
  figureBaseDir = "figures",
  dataBaseDir = "data",
  rBaseDir = "rData",
  writeOutputs = FALSE,
  createPlots = writeOutputs,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

Optional dnaEPICO_preprocessing object returned by preprocessingMinfiEwasWater(). When supplied, svaEnmix() uses x$phenoLC and x$rgSet as in-memory inputs.

phenoFile

Character path to a phenotype file or a data frame containing phenotype data. When x is supplied, a character phenoFile is used as the output path for the phenotype table when writeOutputs = TRUE.

rgsetData

Character path to an RGSet .RData file, an RGSet-like object, or a dnaEPICO_preprocessing object.

sepType

Character. Field separator for phenotype file input.

outputLogs

Character. Directory for optional log files.

nSamples

Integer or NA. Number of samples to subset for testing.

SampleID

Character. Sample identifier column name.

arrayType

Character. Illumina array type retained in the returned parameter metadata.

annotationVersion

Character. Annotation version retained in the returned parameter metadata.

SentrixIDColumn

Character. Sentrix ID column name in the RGSet phenotype data.

SentrixPositionColumn

Character. Sentrix position column name in the RGSet phenotype data.

ctrlSvaPercVar

Numeric. Proportion of variance explained by control probes.

ctrlSvaFlag

Integer. Flag indicating use of control probes.

scriptLabel

Character. Label used in output naming.

tiffWidth

Integer. Width of TIFF plots in pixels.

tiffHeight

Integer. Height of TIFF plots in pixels.

tiffRes

Integer. Resolution (DPI) for TIFF plots.

figureBaseDir

Character. Base directory for figure outputs.

dataBaseDir

Character. Base directory for table outputs.

rBaseDir

Character. Base directory for RData outputs.

writeOutputs

Logical scalar. If TRUE, legacy step-2 files are written to disk.

createPlots

Logical scalar. If TRUE, legacy SVA TIFF plots are written when writeOutputs = TRUE.

verbose

Logical scalar. If TRUE, progress messages are emitted and a log file is written to outputLogs.

Value

A dnaEPICO_sva object. This is a named list containing the aligned phenotype data, RGSet, surrogate-variable matrix, merged phenotype table, technical factors, fitted linear models used for SVA diagnostics, and, when available, upstream methylation matrices retained for downstream preprocessingPheno() use.

Examples

tmp <- tempdir()
stopifnot(dir.exists(tmp))

# \donttest{
sva <- svaEnmix(
  phenoFile = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/phenoLC.csv",
  rgsetData = "rData/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/objects/RGSet.RData",
  sepType = "",
  outputLogs = "logs",
  nSamples = 5,
  SampleID = "Sample_Name",
  arrayType = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2",
  annotationVersion = "20a1.hg38",
  SentrixIDColumn = "Sentrix_ID",
  SentrixPositionColumn = "Sentrix_Position",
  ctrlSvaPercVar = 0.90,
  ctrlSvaFlag = 1,
  scriptLabel = "svaEnmix",
  tiffWidth = 2000,
  tiffHeight = 1000,
  tiffRes = 150,
  figureBaseDir = "figures",
  dataBaseDir = "data",
  rBaseDir = "rData",
  writeOutputs = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
